title: Many Voices in a Text
grammar: Participles before the noun in literary analysis
goal: I can describe a text with a participle before the noun (*a feszültséget fenntartó kép*, *az egymással feleselő hangok*).
I can name how a text speaks in many voices (*polifónia*, *többszólamúság*, *ambivalencia*).
I can write one short sentence about the voices in a poem.
